dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Hmph. It seems that these Knights of Favonius aren't all talk after all. To think that they were able to solve the dragon crisis without the help of the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: But I suppose fortune was also on their side. I've heard that it was only by the intervention of a mysterious traveler that the crisis was finally resolved.

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: I've never seen that traveler before. I wonder what that fellow looks like.

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: But it matters not. Our diplomats have already reported this to the higher-ups. A single traveler couldn't...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: ...Hah! If you thought I'd say more than that, you're sorely mistaken!
